bank.name: Hadith & Sunnah
bank.subject: Islamic Studies
bank.description: The science of hadith, famous collections, narrators and key hadiths.

questions.prompt: What does the word 'Hadith' mean?
options: A saying, action or approval of the Prophet (PBUH)
questions.explanation: Hadith refers to the recorded sayings, actions and tacit approvals of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).

questions.prompt: What is a 'Sahih' hadith?
questions.explanation: Sahih means authentic — a hadith with a sound chain of narrators and text.

questions.prompt: What is 'Isnad' in hadith terminology?
questions.explanation: Isnad is the chain of narrators through whom the hadith was transmitted; Matn is the text.

questions.prompt: What is a 'Hadith Qudsi'?
options: A hadith narrated by a king
A divine saying relayed by the Prophet (PBUH) but not part of the Quran
questions.explanation: Hadith Qudsi is a divine saying of Allah conveyed in the Prophet's (PBUH) words — distinct from the Quran.

questions.prompt: How many hadiths does Sahih al-Bukhari contain approximately?
questions.explanation: Sahih al-Bukhari contains about 2,600 unique hadiths (roughly 7,275 with repetitions).

questions.prompt: Who is known as 'Ameer-ul-Momineen fil-Hadith' (leader of the faithful in hadith)?
questions.explanation: Imam Bukhari earned this title for his unmatched mastery of hadith.

questions.prompt: Which hadith collection is called 'Al-Jami al-Sahih' and is second in authenticity after Bukhari?
questions.explanation: Sahih Muslim is the second most authentic hadith collection.

questions.prompt: What is 'Sunan' in hadith literature?
options: Collections arranged by topics of fiqh
questions.explanation: Sunan collections (Abu Dawood, Nasa'i, Ibn Majah) are arranged by legal topics.

questions.prompt: What is a 'Musnad' collection?
options: Arranged by the names of the companions who narrated
A collection of only weak hadiths
questions.explanation: Musnad collections, like Imam Ahmad's Musnad, group hadiths by the narrating companion.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Mishkat al-Masabih', a famous selection of hadiths?
questions.explanation: Waliuddin al-Tabrizi compiled Mishkat al-Masabih, widely used in South Asian seminaries.

questions.prompt: What is 'Rijal al-Hadith'?
options: The science of evaluating hadith narrators
questions.explanation: Ilm al-Rijal is the science of assessing the reliability of hadith narrators.

questions.prompt: What is a 'Mursal' hadith?
options: One in which a successor (Tabi'i) narrates directly from the Prophet (PBUH) omitting the companion
questions.explanation: Mursal is a hadith where the Tabi'i drops the companion from the chain, which scholars debate as weaker.

questions.prompt: What is 'Maudu' (fabricated) hadith?
options: A hadith invented and falsely attributed to the Prophet (PBUH)
questions.explanation: Maudu means fabricated or forged — a hadith falsely attributed to the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: How many hadiths are in the collection 'Riyad al-Salihin'?
questions.explanation: Imam Nawawi's Riyad al-Salihin contains roughly 1,900 hadiths organized by virtue and manners.

questions.prompt: Which companion is reported to have narrated the most hadiths?
questions.explanation: Abu Hurairah (RA) narrated about 5,374 hadiths, the most of any companion.

questions.prompt: The famous hadith 'Actions are judged by intentions' (Innamal a'malu bin-niyyah) is found at the beginning of which collection?
questions.explanation: It opens Sahih al-Bukhari and is widely considered the first hadith a student memorizes.

questions.prompt: What is 'Matn' in hadith terminology?
questions.explanation: Matn is the actual text/content of the hadith, as opposed to the Isnad (chain).

questions.prompt: Which scholar compiled 'Al-Adab al-Mufrad', dedicated to hadiths on manners and character?
questions.explanation: Imam Bukhari authored Al-Adab al-Mufrad, a collection of hadiths on Islamic manners.

questions.prompt: What does 'Muttafaqun Alaih' mean?
options: A hadith agreed upon by Bukhari and Muslim
A hadith agreed upon by all four Imams
questions.explanation: Muttafaqun Alaih refers to hadiths recorded by both Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim.

questions.prompt: Who compiled 'Jami al-Tirmidhi'?
questions.explanation: Imam Abu Isa Muhammad al-Tirmidhi (824-892) compiled Jami al-Tirmidhi, known for grading hadiths.

questions.prompt: Which hadith book is considered the 'Sahih' of Imam Ibn Khuzaymah?
questions.explanation: Ibn Khuzaymah's Sahih is one of the early authentic collections, though partially lost.

questions.prompt: The hadith 'Seeking knowledge is obligatory upon every Muslim' is narrated by whom?
questions.explanation: This famous hadith is recorded by Ibn Majah (and others), urging every Muslim to seek knowledge.

questions.prompt: What is the 'Isnad' status of a hadith narrated only by one person at some link?
questions.explanation: Ahad hadiths are narrated by limited chains, as opposed to Mutawatir (mass-transmitted).

questions.prompt: Who is known for compiling 'Sunan al-Kubra', a major collection, and died in 1066 CE?
questions.explanation: Imam al-Bayhaqi's Sunan al-Kubra is one of the largest hadith compilations.

questions.prompt: The 'Forty Hadith' collection (Al-Arba'in) was compiled by which famous scholar?
questions.explanation: Imam Nawawi's Forty Hadith (Al-Arba'in al-Nawawiyyah) is among the most studied hadith books.

questions.prompt: What is 'Ilm-ul-Dirayah' in hadith science?
options: The study of the text (matn) of hadith
questions.explanation: Dirayah evaluates the hadith text; Riwayah transmits the reports.

questions.prompt: What is 'Al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil'?
options: The science of declaring narrators reliable or discredited
questions.explanation: Al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil assesses narrator credibility in hadith science.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a 'Sahih' condition set by Bukhari and Muslim?
options: Continuity of chain, upright narrators, and sound text
questions.explanation: Authenticity requires an unbroken chain of trustworthy, precise narrators.

questions.prompt: What is a 'Hadith Hasan'?
options: A good hadith with a slight weakness in precision but acceptable
questions.explanation: Hasan hadiths are good — their narrators are less precise but still acceptable.

questions.prompt: The famous hadith 'The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it' is in?
questions.explanation: This hadith is recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari.

questions.prompt: What is 'Riwayah' in hadith?
options: The transmission and narration of hadith
questions.explanation: Riwayah is narrating hadith with its chain; Dirayah is critical evaluation.

questions.prompt: The hadith 'Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should honour his guest' emphasizes?
questions.explanation: This hadith (Bukhari/Muslim) teaches honouring guests as part of faith.

questions.prompt: The famous hadith on intentions ('Actions are by intentions') was narrated by which companion?
questions.explanation: Umar (RA) narrated the hadith of intentions, opening Sahih al-Bukhari.

questions.prompt: What is 'Tadlis' in hadith?
options: Concealing a weakness in the chain of narrators
questions.explanation: Tadlis is a narrator's concealment of whom they heard from — a criticized practice.

questions.prompt: The hadith 'Paradise lies at the feet of mothers' teaches?
questions.explanation: The hadith emphasizes the supreme status and honour of mothers.

questions.prompt: Which companion narrated the 'Hadith of Jibril' defining Islam, Iman and Ihsan?
questions.explanation: Umar (RA) narrated the famous Hadith of Jibril in Sahih Muslim.

questions.prompt: What is the 'Khutbat al-Wada' (Farewell Sermon)?
options: The Prophet's (PBUH) final sermon at the Farewell Hajj in 10 AH
questions.explanation: The Farewell Sermon at Arafat in 10 AH summarized Islam's core teachings.

questions.prompt: The hadith 'Religion is sincerity (naseehah)' was said three times, referring to?
options: Sincerity to Allah, His Book, His Messenger, leaders and all Muslims
questions.explanation: The hadith defines Naseehah across five spheres — the core of social ethics.

questions.prompt: Which hadith collection is titled 'Sunan al-Nasa'i' and known for strict narrator standards?
questions.explanation: Imam al-Nasa'i's Sunan is famous for rigorous scrutiny of narrators.

questions.prompt: The hadith 'Seek knowledge even unto China' is considered by scholars as?
options: Widely quoted but weak (da'if) in its chain
questions.explanation: Scholars classify 'Seek knowledge even unto China' as weak but commonly cited.

questions.prompt: Which hadith book is regarded as the most authentic after the Quran?
questions.explanation: Sahih al-Bukhari is the most authentic book after the Quran.

questions.prompt: The famous hadith on intentions begins with whose narration?
questions.explanation: Umar (RA) narrated the hadith 'Actions are by intentions'.

questions.prompt: What is a 'Muttawatir' hadith?
options: Narrated by many chains in every generation
questions.explanation: Muttawatir is transmitted by numerous narrators at every level.

questions.prompt: Who was the first to collect hadith into a formal book?
options: Umar bin Abdul Aziz ordered the first compilation
questions.explanation: Umar bin Abdul Aziz commissioned the first hadith compilation.

questions.prompt: The hadith 'Seeking knowledge is obligatory on every Muslim' highlights:
questions.explanation: The hadith urges the pursuit of knowledge.

questions.prompt: Who was the companion famous for collecting hadith in the scroll 'Al-Sahifah al-Sadiqah'?
questions.explanation: Abdullah bin Amr recorded hadith in a scroll.

questions.prompt: The hadith of 'Gabriel' teaches about:
questions.explanation: The Hadith of Gabriel explains the three levels of faith.

questions.prompt: Which hadith collection is known for its 'Muwatta' by the Imam of Madinah?
questions.explanation: Imam Malik's Muwatta is an early Madinan compilation.

questions.prompt: The hadith 'None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself' teaches:
questions.explanation: It emphasises sincere love for fellow believers.

questions.prompt: The hadith 'The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it' highlights:
questions.explanation: It praises those who learn and teach the Quran.

questions.prompt: What is a 'Hasan' hadith?
questions.explanation: Hasan denotes a hadith of good, acceptable authenticity.

questions.prompt: Who was the famous companion called 'the interpreter of the Quran'?
questions.explanation: Ibn Abbas was renowned for Quranic interpretation.

questions.prompt: The 'Sahih al-Bukhari' contains approximately how many hadith?
questions.explanation: Bukhari compiled around 7,275 hadith including repetitions.

questions.prompt: The hadith about 'mercy to animals' teaches Muslims to:
questions.explanation: Islam emphasises compassion for all creatures.

questions.prompt: What does 'Sahih Muslim' share with Bukhari besides authenticity?
questions.explanation: Both are the two most authentic hadith collections.

questions.prompt: The hadith 'Cleanliness is half of faith' refers to:
questions.explanation: Taharah covers both outward and inner cleanliness.

questions.prompt: The famous hadith on 'Ummah's unity' says the believers are like:
questions.explanation: Believers are likened to one body in mutual care.

questions.prompt: Who is known as the 'Sahabi of the Quran' who served the Prophet's (PBUH) household?
questions.explanation: Anas served the Prophet (PBUH) for ten years.

questions.prompt: What does the hadith 'The strong believer is better than the weak believer' refer to?
questions.explanation: It praises strength in faith and resolve.

questions.prompt: The 'Sahifa of Hammam bin Munabbih' is a famous early collection narrated by:
questions.explanation: Hammam's scroll preserves hadith from Abu Huraira.

questions.prompt: A 'Jami'' hadith collection covers which scope?
options: All eight subjects of hadith classification
questions.explanation: A Jami' is arranged to cover all subjects of the Prophet's (PBUH) affairs.

questions.prompt: A hadith narrated by a single narrator at some stage is called?
questions.explanation: Gharib is a hadith narrated by only one person at some level of the chain.

questions.prompt: A 'Shadh' (irregular) hadith is one that?
options: Conflicts with a more reliable narration despite a reliable narrator
questions.explanation: Shadh is narrated by a trustworthy narrator but contradicts a stronger chain.

questions.prompt: A 'Munkar' hadith is one that?
options: Comes from a weak narrator and conflicts with reliable reports
questions.explanation: Munkar is a hadith whose weak narrator opposes a more reliable narration.

questions.prompt: A hadith with a missing narrator in its chain is called?
questions.explanation: Munqati' means the chain is broken at some point.

questions.prompt: A hadith with two consecutive narrators missing is called?
questions.explanation: Mu'dal has a gap of two or more narrators in the chain.

questions.prompt: Sahih Muslim contains approximately how many hadith (excluding repetitions)?
questions.explanation: Sahih Muslim contains roughly 3,000 hadith excluding repetitions.

questions.prompt: Which companion was called the most knowledgeable of the Ummah about Halal and Haram?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) said Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) was the most learned in Halal and Haram.

questions.prompt: 'Takhrij' of a hadith refers to?
options: Tracing the hadith to its original sources
questions.explanation: Takhrij is the process of locating a hadith in its source collections with its chains.

questions.prompt: A report attributed to a companion is called?
questions.explanation: Mawquf is a narration traced back to a companion only.

questions.prompt: A report attributed to a successor (Tabi'i) is called?
questions.explanation: Maqtu' is a narration attributed to a Tabi'i.

questions.prompt: A hadith attributed directly to the Prophet (PBUH) is called?
questions.explanation: Marfu' is a report raised to the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: A 'Hasan li-ghayrihi' hadith is?
options: A hadith elevated to Hasan by supporting chains
questions.explanation: Hasan li-ghayrihi is strengthened to Hasan through corroborating narrations.

questions.prompt: In hadith terminology, a 'Hafiz' is?
options: A scholar who has memorised a vast number of hadith with their chains
questions.explanation: A Hafiz is a master memoriser of hadith and their chains.

questions.prompt: A 'Muhaddith' is?
questions.explanation: A Muhaddith is a specialist in the science of hadith.

questions.prompt: Imam Nawawi's famous commentary on Sahih Muslim is called?
questions.explanation: Nawawi's Sharh Sahih Muslim is titled Al-Minhaj.

questions.prompt: 'Bulugh al-Maram', a collection of fiqh hadith, was compiled by?
questions.explanation: Bulugh al-Maram is Ibn Hajar's concise collection of legal hadith.

questions.prompt: 'Riyad al-Salihin' was compiled by?
questions.explanation: Imam Nawawi compiled Riyad al-Salihin, a famous book of hadith.

questions.prompt: A 'Silsilah' in hadith refers to?
questions.explanation: Silsilah is the continuous chain linking the narrator to the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: Among the women, who narrated the most hadith?
questions.explanation: Aisha (RA) narrated over two thousand hadith, the most among women.

questions.prompt: The four 'Sunan' books are collectively known as?
questions.explanation: The Sunan of Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Nasa'i and Ibn Majah form Al-Kutub al-Arba'ah.

questions.prompt: Which of the four Sunan is generally regarded as the strongest?
questions.explanation: Sunan Abu Dawood is often ranked highest among the four Sunan.

questions.prompt: The study of hidden defects in hadith is called?
questions.explanation: Ilal al-Hadith investigates the hidden flaws that weaken a narration.

questions.prompt: A hadith with a hidden defect is called?
questions.explanation: Ma'lul is a hadith with an obscure defect despite an apparent soundness.

questions.prompt: 'Al-Shaykhayn' in hadith science refers to?
options: Imam Abu Hanifa and Imam Malik
questions.explanation: The two Shaykhs are Bukhari and Muslim, compilers of the Sahihayn.

questions.prompt: 'Al-Sahihayn' refers to?
options: Sahih Ibn Hibban and Sahih Ibn Khuzaymah
questions.explanation: Al-Sahihayn are the two most authentic collections: Bukhari and Muslim.

questions.prompt: The hadith 'A believer is the mirror of his brother' teaches?
questions.explanation: The hadith encourages believers to sincerely point out each other's faults with care.

questions.prompt: The hadith 'Part of the perfection of one's Islam is leaving what does not concern him' teaches?
questions.explanation: This hadith urges believers to avoid what does not benefit them.

questions.prompt: Which hadith states that the most complete believers are those with the best character?
options: 'The most complete of believers in faith are those with the best character'
'The strong believer is better than the weak'
questions.explanation: Tirmidhi records that the best in faith are those with the finest character.

questions.prompt: Which companion narrated the hadith 'Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt'?
questions.explanation: The hadith on leaving doubts is narrated from Hasan bin Ali (RA).

questions.prompt: What is 'Ilm al-Rijal'?
options: The study of the narrators' reliability
questions.explanation: Ilm al-Rijal evaluates the narrators in the chains.

questions.prompt: The scholar known as 'the father of hadith criticism' is often considered to be?
questions.explanation: Yahya ibn Ma'in was a pioneer of hadith criticism alongside Ahmad ibn Hanbal.

questions.prompt: Which of the Prophet's (PBUH) companions is the narrator of the longest hadith on the Day of Judgment?
questions.explanation: The long hadith on the Hour is reported by Nu'man bin Bashir (RA).

questions.prompt: Which collection is titled 'Sahih al-Jami'' by Imam al-Albani?
options: A modern authenticated compilation of sahih hadith
questions.explanation: Al-Albani's Sahih al-Jami' gathers authentic narrations verified by him.

questions.prompt: The hadith 'The world is sweet and green, and Allah has made you vicegerents in it' warns about?
questions.explanation: The hadith warns against being overcome by the attractions of this world.

questions.prompt: Which companion was nicknamed 'the one who narrates too much' and had a cloak for spreading hadith?
questions.explanation: Abu Hurairah (RA) spread his cloak to gather the Prophet's (PBUH) words.

questions.prompt: The hadith 'The best provision is taqwa' is found in?
questions.explanation: 'The best provision is taqwa' is a Quranic verse (2:197).

questions.prompt: Who narrated the hadith 'None of you believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself'?
questions.explanation: Anas bin Malik (RA) narrated this famous hadith of brotherhood.

questions.prompt: What is the position of a 'Mawquf' hadith in fiqh?
options: It is a companion's report, not the Prophet's (PBUH) statement
questions.explanation: Mawquf reports stop at a companion and are weaker than marfu' reports.

questions.prompt: Which scholar is known for compiling 'Al-Kutub al-Sittah' methodology and wrote 'Muqaddimah Ibn al-Salah'?
questions.explanation: Ibn al-Salah's Muqaddimah is a classic introduction to hadith sciences.
